summary: Setting up the types and categories for student feedback within the system, which are used by teachers when providing feedback.
navigation: Student Feedback Type / Student Feedback Category
steps: Define 'Student Feedback Type' options (e.g., Positive, Negative, Neutral) which will appear as a dropdown for teachers.
Define 'Student Feedback Category' options (e.g., Academic Performance, Sports, Co-curricular, Behavior) which will also appear as a dropdown.
business_rules: Feedback types and categories are configured at the institute level and apply system-wide.
These configurations are a prerequisite for teachers to be able to give structured student feedback.
important_notes: Proper setup of feedback types and categories ensures consistent and organized feedback collection.
These settings directly impact the options available to teachers when they provide feedback.
